text: {"lessons":["My account rose modestly at first, but recent declines show that stock values can move against me; I should keep risk and my living needs in mind.","I made no trades, and that avoided impulsive decisions, but I should still review my holdings and recent prices before deciding whether to act.","A few months of results are not enough to predict what comes next; I should avoid chasing short-term gains or reacting hastily to small losses."]}
